reason: Both correctly identify normal cooling-fan run-on, require no parts or escalation, and avoid unsupported fault claims. Conversation 2 edges ahead by giving the homeowner a concrete boundary for when it would be a fault ('grinding, scraping, or loud rattling' and 'eventually stops on its own'), which better matches the expected direction of flagging a constant-run or abnormal-noise case. Conversation 1 is also sound and gives a useful ~10 minute threshold, but is slightly more absolute ('simply a feature') without noting what abnormal would sound like; neither asks about grill/convection timing, so the difference is small.
